meta.source: Black-box reverse engineering of GramaGo (com.tranhuy.projectx). Canonical window 788x1083pt; alternate 554x772 (S047-S050, S001-554 only); canvas 908x1083 (S051).
meta.evidence: 77 PNGs / 21 AX snapshots (43 files). 63 state IDs / 62 distinct evidenced states (S058 = active alias of S010): S001–S050 (S038 unused) + S051–S054 + S055–S064 (final targeted crawl). Reconciled 2026-10-09.

confidence.measured: bounds from the macOS accessibility tree (integer-rounded, +/-1); colour hex = exact pixel values read from 1x screenshots (flat fills; text colours are the darkest glyph pixel and so are lower bounds on darkness)
confidence.estimated: corner radii (circle fit to corner pixels, rms ~0.5-1.6 px, valid only for the 1x capture), shadows (falloff read off three sheet edges)
confidence.missing: font family/sizes/weights, border widths, dark mode, motion, Home ModeCard 02/03 fill + radius (card 01 only), Flow Letter gradient stops (point samples), corner radius of the sheet bottom corners

rules.inactiveWindow: Captures with a greyed traffic-light (32 of 63) support structure/layout ONLY. They must not define canonical fills, enabled/disabled states or opacity. Home ModeCard fill, Home banner, deck header, menu backdrop and submit-enabled grey were all proven wrong this way.
rules.viewport: Canonical = 788x1083. 554x772 is ~0.704x content scale; none of its values are tokens. 908x1083 is a canvas (window + desktop strip), geometry = 788.
rules.colourEncoding: PNGs carry three encodings: untagged sRGB (S001-S018 originals), a 'Display' profile (S019-S046), and Display P3 (13:36+ captures). Raw hex from P3/Display files is NOT sRGB. Each colour below is tagged with its encoding; values marked sRGBnormalised were converted with the embedded profile (rendering intent 0). P3 blues/greens shift by 10-20 per channel.
rules.confidence: measured = pixel read; fit = circle fit to corner pixels (1x, ±1.5pt); estimated; inferred; candidate = unverified in an active canonical capture
